summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Wetnose Veterinary Clinic admin panel. Backend APIs are fully functional with 100% success rate. Frontend admin panel has authentication session persistence issues affecting some pages.

integration_issues.issue: Authentication session not persisting across page navigations - users redirected to login page when accessing /admin/team, /admin/testimonials, and /admin/gallery directly
Some admin pages show loading state or empty content after authentication

passed_tests: Backend API authentication with admin credentials
All public API endpoints (Settings, Services, Team, Blog, Gallery, Testimonials, Slider)
Admin API endpoints (Services, Team Members, Blog, Gallery, Testimonials)
CRUD operations via API (Create Service, Create Team Member, Create Blog Post)
Services page navigation and UI elements
Blog page navigation with create button functionality
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix authentication session persistence issue in admin panel. Users are being redirected to login page when navigating directly to /admin/team, /admin/testimonials, and /admin/gallery pages. This suggests JWT token storage or validation issues in the frontend authentication middleware.
